description: This file defines an abstract class 'KeyDetector' used for detecting key presses and nearby keys in a custom keyboard view, including handling proximity correction, shift key status, and key set management.

classes.name: KeyDetector
classes.description: An abstract class responsible for detecting key presses and nearby keys, managing proximity correction, and shift key status in a custom keyboard view.

methods.name: setKeyboard
methods.description: Sets the current keyboard and shift key, updating the internal key array.

methods.name: setCorrection
methods.description: Sets the correction offsets for touch coordinates.

methods.name: getTouchX
methods.description: Returns the corrected x-coordinate for a touch event.

methods.name: getTouchY
methods.description: Returns the corrected y-coordinate for a touch event.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns the current array of keys.

methods.name: setProximityThreshold
methods.description: Sets the proximity threshold for nearby key detection.

methods.name: newCodeArray
methods.description: Allocates and initializes an array for nearby key codes.

methods.name: getMaxNearbyKeys
methods.description: Abstract method to compute maximum number of nearby keys.

methods.name: getKeyIndexAndNearbyCodes
methods.description: Abstract method to find nearby key indices around a touch point.

methods.name: isKeyShifted
methods.description: Determines if a given key is shifted based on current keyboard state.
